camel_example: aliyun polardb AddPolarFsQuota --region cn-hangzhou --Quotas.1.Description quota_policy --Quotas.1.Priority 1 --Quotas.1.FileCountLimit 222 --Quotas.1.ChangeTTL 7200 --Quotas.1.Exclude '/a/0project0' --Quotas.1.SizeLimit 1 --PolarFsInstanceId 'pfs-2ze0i74ka60700000' --Quotas.1.AccessTTL 7200 --Quotas.1.Enabled true --Quotas.1.Include '/b/0project0' --Quotas.1.Name rule1
description_en: Adds a new directory quota rule to a Polarlakebase instance
description_zh: 为Polarlakebase实例添加新的目录配额规则
kebab_example: aliyun polardb add-polar-fs-quota --polar-fs-instance-id pfs-2ze0i74ka60700000 --quotas Description=quota_policy Exclude=/a/0project0 ChangeTTL=7200 FileCountLimit=222 Priority=1 SizeLimit=1 Include=/b/0project0 AccessTTL=7200 Enabled=true Name=rule1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddPolarFsQuota

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. Valid values:

True: The rule immediately applies to new items. This is the default value.

False: The rule does not apply to new items
fields.help_zh:
规则是否启用，取值如下：
True：新增事件对新事物立即生效，默认值
False：新增事件对新事物不生效
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en:
The rule to exclude specific paths from matching.

A path pattern that starts with a forward slash (/). Supports glob syntax, including `*`, `?`, and `**`
fields.help_zh:
排除特定路径的匹配规则
以 `/` 开头的路径模式（支持 `*`、`?`、`**` 的 glob 语法）
fields.name: exclude

fields.help_en: The limit on the number of files for a user in the directory
fields.help_zh: 目录下用户的文件数目限制
fields.name: file_count_limit

fields.help_en:
The wildcard pattern to match paths.

A path pattern that starts with a forward slash (/). Supports glob syntax, including `*`, `?`, and `**`
fields.help_zh:
匹配路径的通配模式
以 `/` 开头的路径模式（支持 `*`、`?、`**` 的 glob 语法）
fields.name: include

fields.help_en: The priority of the quota rule
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en:
The total size limit for files in the directory. Unit: GB.

Note: The value must be at least 1 GB
fields.help_zh:
限制目录下文件总容量。单位：GB
说明：不小于1GB
